subject: Fiscal entity billing matrix & collector onboarding for Helix Health
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@eu-tax.co.uk>
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 09:14:00 +0100
Subject: Billing split between UK and EU entities — VAT handling question

Hi Grace,

Thanks again for the demo last week. Finance at Helix is trying to close the PO but we hit a snag on the legal entity field for invoicing. Our procurement team needs the invoice split across two paying entities: Helix Health Ltd (UK, GB VAT) and Helix Health EU BV (NL, intra-EU). The tricky part is VAT: they want line-level allocation so UK domestic VAT is charged where applicable and the EU entity uses reverse-charge for certain seat charges.

Can Redwood produce a single consolidated invoice PDF that shows the split by line with separate VAT calculations per entity? If not, we need an alternative: either two invoices tied to one contract or a clear split summary CSV (we can upload to our AP). Also, we need to ensure the collector routing maps payments to the correct accounting codes.

I’m looping in our tax adviser, Maya, in case you need statutory guidance. We’d like a short playbook / annotated matrix that our AP team can hand to their ERP (Coupa) by Aug 22 to meet month-end. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Procurement
Helix Health

---
Attachment: PO_8245-Helix.pdf (application/pdf)

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 12 Aug 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing split between UK and EU entities — VAT handling question

Elena,

Appreciate the detail — we can absolutely support line-level visibility. High-level options:

- Single consolidated PDF with an attached CSV that contains per-line entity tags, VAT rates, and accounting code (our billing export format).
- Two separate invoices per entity, referencing the same master contract and PO (clean for AP systems that cannot import split lines).

Operationally we’ll need two things from your side: a mapping of Helix accounting codes to our internal cost-centers, and confirmation of which SKU groups are subject to UK VAT vs reverse-charge.

I’ll put Ben and Marissa on this thread to draft the delivery matrix and collector routing. Ben — can you confirm timing for the CSV schema and whether we can include per-line tax_id and tax_rule columns? Marissa — can you prepare a first-pass matrix (sample rows + suggested collector assignment) by EOD Thursday (Aug 14)?

Grace O'Connor
Sr. Customer Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0178

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 13 Aug 2025 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Billing split between UK and EU entities — VAT handling question

Quick clarifying questions before we lock the schema:

1) Do we need to emit country-specific VAT registration numbers on each line for legal compliance, or is it sufficient to include a per-entity tax_id at the invoice header and a reference column on each line? Some AP systems insist on visible VAT NBs per line.
2) Payment routing: does Helix want us to set up two separate collector accounts (one GBP, one EUR) or a single multi-currency collector with remittance mapping? Two collectors is cleaner for automated cash-apply but increases bank fee complexity.
3) Would Helix accept a two-invoice approach as an interim solution while we build line-level CSV export?

I’ll stand up a quick example CSV and a mapping template for Coupa import. Marissa — I’ll put the CSV stub into the shared drive link and attach when ready.

Ben Carter
Billing Operations Lead | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@helixhealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 15 Aug 2025 16:40:00 +0100
Subject: Re: Billing split between UK and EU entities — VAT handling question

Hi Elena, Grace,

Attached is the first-pass billing matrix (Helix_SPLIT_MATRIX_v1.xlsx) and a short checklist for collector onboarding to reduce cash-apply exceptions. Highlights:

- Approach recommended: consolidated invoice PDF + attached CSV (per-line entity_code, tax_id, tax_rule, currency, accounting_code). This satisfies Helix’s desire for a single document while giving AP a machine-friendly file.
- Interim fallback: we can issue two invoices for the same PO; we will reference the master PO and include cross-references to the sibling invoice.
- Tax fields: we will populate invoice header tax_id for each entity. In the CSV we will also include per-line tax_rate and a "tax_note" column for reverse-charge indicators. If Coupa requires VAT number visibility on each invoice line, we can duplicate the header tax_id onto each line.
- Collector recommendation: two collectors (GBP and EUR) mapped to Helix accounting_code 4001 (UK ops) and 4002 (EU ops). We will also send a remittance file (CSV) nightly to your AR mailbox to assist auto-match.

Next steps / asks from Helix:
- Confirm acceptance of the consolidated+CSV approach by Aug 22 so we can schedule the Coupa import.
- Confirm accounting code mapping (attached sheet tab: Helix_GL_Map).
- Confirm whether your AP team prefers two separate bank receivers or a single receiver with sub-ledger mapping.

I’ve attached the sample matrix and the signed MOP addendum (Signed_MOP_Addendum.pdf) for recordkeeping.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
